title: [AUG-179] Research: Windows onboarding without manual MCP environment variables
why_we_need_this: From the conversation with Rodion: if August becomes a paid product, Windows needs a proper onboarding — today MCP setup requires adding environment variables by hand, which blocks non-technical users. Source: @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Current first-run and MCP setup steps on Windows and macOS listed with file:line refs and every manual step marked.
- [ ] Options compared for removing manual steps (installer writes config, in-app setup wizard, auto-detection) with trade-offs.
- [ ] HTML mockup: a self-contained file @docs/mockups/AUG-179/onboarding.html (opens in a browser, no build) with a clickable step-by-step first-run flow for the recommended option (success and error states for MCP setup); built on August's real design tokens (frontend-design route, 0 border-radius).
- [ ] Recommendation given; the proposal is agreed with the user on the mockup (AskUserQuestion); the decision is recorded in this card.
- [ ] CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with the agreed scope, SMART acceptance criteria and a link to the chosen mockup is created on the board; its ID is written into this card and into the roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints: Research only — no code changes. Closed only by creating the agreed implementation task. Tied to the paid-version decision — can be parked until then. Roadmap: M3 Compact & onboarding. Order: 10/10.
